note: Licensed movement clips for CHE's MPFB game_engine skeleton. Source frames are 120 fps; frame 0 of every CMU BVH file is the converter's added T-pose and is used only as the retargeting reference. Files are downloaded at build time from the pinned commit below, verified by sha256 and cached (CHE_MOTION_CACHE); they are not stored in the repository.

cmu.name: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database, BVH conversion by Bruce Hahne (2010 MotionBuilder-friendly release)
cmu.licence: CMU: 'This data is free for use in research and commercial projects worldwide' (quoted in the release's READMEFIRST.txt v1.1, 2010, with B. Hahne adding no restrictions). The current mocap.cs.cmu.edu FAQ (not reachable from this container, from memory, unverified live) adds that the data may be included in commercially-sold products but not resold directly, even converted; CHE ships retargeted motion inside its characters and never redistributes the raw files.
cmu.credit: The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.

13_04.description: sit on stepstool, chin in hand

walk_in_turn.description: walks forward about 1.8 m and turns 90 degrees to her left

walk_turn_sit.description: walks a short arc, turns around and sits down on a chair-height seat (same take as seated_gesture)

sit_down.description: stands, lowers onto a low stool (seat about 0.45 m) and settles; knees apart

seated_idle.description: seated, hands on the lap, small posture shifts

talk_gesture.description: explains with both hands while standing (upper body is layered over other clips)

seated_gesture.description: seated (same seat as walk_turn_sit), talks with both hands

turn_in_place.description: turns on the spot one way and back

seated_rest.description: seated after walk_turn_sit, small posture shifts
